description: Invite a collaborator by email. Requires Pro/Scale on the project owner. Only the owner can invite as admin. Creates a new project on the caller's account if you use create_project instead — pass project_id here. Do not share the owner's nv_ key.

email.description: Invitee's email. They accept with accept_project_invite.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.

role.description: Access level. Default editor. Only the owner can grant admin.

name: invite_project_member
title: Invite project member
